title: sport-lang entrant state
description: One entrant’s day as an engine answers it (SPEC.md §4): what the rules made of the log, and never a placing. A finisher has `finished_at`; an entrant who started and did not finish has `started_at` and no `finished_at`, and `withdrew` says whether they said so; an entrant who never started is absent, because an engine’s entrants are the log’s. `total_ms` of a non-finisher runs to their last read and is not a time to rank. `applied` is every rule that fired, with its sentence. Generated from ts/src/fold.ts by ts/scripts/make-schema.ts; do not edit by hand.

anyOf.description: An instant in UTC: `2026-08-14T16:48:00.000Z`. Milliseconds optional, offset always `Z`, and a day that exists — which the pattern alone cannot check (SPEC.md §2.3).

started_at.description: The first `started`, or null: never seen starting.

anyOf.description: An instant in UTC: `2026-08-14T16:48:00.000Z`. Milliseconds optional, offset always `Z`, and a day that exists — which the pattern alone cannot check (SPEC.md §2.3).

finished_at.description: The last `finished`, or null: not (yet) a finisher. On a lapped course every lap line is a `finished`, so a finisher there is one whose `laps` is the number of laps.

withdrew.description: Whether a `withdrew` was observed. A fact, not a standing.

total_ms.description: Moving time plus every penalty, to `finished_at` — or to the last read when there is none, so a non-finisher’s total is not a time to rank. Null when never seen starting.

adjustment_ms.description: The sum of every `adjust_time` that fired.

neutralised_ms.description: Time the document took off the clock (`neutralise`).

laps.description: `finished` observations: one per lap line crossed, 1 for a finisher of a one-lap course.

classes.description: Each `classify` that fired, the latest per dimension.

applied.description: Every rule that fired, in the order it fired, with its sentence: the reason, in words.
